exception: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'executionCount')
rootCause: When an active Liquidity Program exists, getProgramView succeeds and useProgramReadModel builds the ON_CHAIN snapshot. latestExecution is often empty (0 executions / not yet returned), so result[0] is undefined. activityFromLatestExecution expected { executionCount, latest } and immediately read input.executionCount — crashing the setup/read-model render. Separately, forceExpanded + step=setup always opened create wizard even when inventory already had programs.
minimalFix: Pass structured { executionCount, latest } from useProgramReadModel
Do not auto-start create when inventory has programs; step=setup with existing programs returns to portfolio
